page_title: GET 2-1 ATM | Getafe v Atletico Madrid 09/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+12' Although Yellu Santiago (Getafe) is just on the bench, Guillermo Cuadra has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
90+12' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+12' Getafe can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+11' Juanmi (Getafe) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Guillermo Cuadra had an easy-decision to make.
90+10' Ramon Terrats (Getafe) misses the target from a promising position, sending the ball well wide of the left post.
90+9' One of the players from Getafe times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+8' Guillermo Cuadra shows a yellow card to Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) for his blatant foul.
90+7' Diego Rico (Getafe) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box.
90+2' 2 - 1 Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) deflects his teammate's shot and the ball goes past the goalkeeper and into the back of the net!
90' We will have 10 min. of added time.
88' 1 - 1 Goal! Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and strikes the ball into the bottom left corner.
88' RED card! Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) can’t believe it as the referee orders him from the pitch following the VAR review.

86' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid), but referee Guillermo Cuadra must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
85' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) takes out his opponent with a horrific tackle and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
85' Atl. Madrid couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as David Soria (Getafe) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
85' It looks like Diego Rico (Getafe) saw red with that tackle. Guillermo Cuadra won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Atl. Madrid.
84' Getafe couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Jan Oblak (Atl. Madrid) leaped high and intercepted the cross.

83' The game is interrupted. Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Getafe have been awarded a free kick.
81' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Guillermo Cuadra no option but to blow his whistle.
80' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to make a change. Juanmi (Getafe) replaces Luis Milla.
79' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Getafe.
78' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) is challenged in the air near the penalty spot and is unable to control his header from the corner, sending it miles over the bar.
77' The ball goes out of play. Getafe are awarded a corner kick.
75' 0 - 1 Goal! Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past David Soria into the bottom right corner.
75' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) is going to take the penalty!
74' Christantus Uche (Getafe) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
74' Diego Rico (Getafe) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
74' The Atl. Madrid players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

74' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Atl. Madrid.
73' That looked a certain handball by Omar Alderete (Getafe) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
69' Substitution. Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Antoine Griezmann walks off.
68' Juan Bernat (Getafe) comes onto the pitch because Coba Gomez da Costa simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
67' Coba Gomez da Costa (Getafe) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
66' Diego Simeone prepares a substitution. Nahuel Molina is replaced by Thomas Lemar (Atl. Madrid).
65' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Getafe, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
65' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle. Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) commits a foul after dangerous play. It's a free kick to Getafe in a dangerous position.
63' Ramon Terrats (Getafe) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jan Oblak intercepts the ball.
62' Jose Bordalas Jimenez decides to make a substitution. Alvaro Rodriguez will be replaced by Borja Mayoral (Getafe).
60' Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
58' The substitution has been made. Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) has replaced Julian Alvarez.
57' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe) was quite harsh and Guillermo Cuadra didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
56' The ball possession at the moment is 30:70.
54' Atl. Madrid are ruled offside.
52' Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Guillermo Cuadra blows for a foul.
51' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
51' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
50' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The linesman makes the right call and Atl. Madrid will have a corner.
48' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
46' Diego Simeone has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) comes on the pitch for Rodrigo de Paul.
46' Half-time substitution. Samuel Lino is replaced by Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
43' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Atl. Madrid was in an offside position.
42' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.

40' Christantus Uche (Getafe) leaps highest in the penalty area to get on the end of a cross from the set piece, and he produces a promising goal-bound header towards the middle of the goal, but Jan Oblak pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
40' Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) gets a yellow card. The referee Guillermo Cuadra made the right call.
40' The referee is firm and issues Omar Alderete (Getafe) a deserved yellow card.
38' Djene (Getafe) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
36' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) commits a rough challenge and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for an infringement.
35' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
33' Guillermo Cuadra has a clear sight and sees a foul from Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid).
33' Domingos Duarte (Getafe) is able to continue to play.
32' Domingos Duarte (Getafe) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
32' Coba Gomez da Costa (Getafe) picks up a rebound after a melee on the edge of the box. His first-time shot is poor, though, and curls well wide of the right post.
31' Luis Milla (Getafe) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
31' Diego Rico (Getafe) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The referee signals a corner kick to Getafe.
30' Coba Gomez da Costa (Getafe) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
30' Atl. Madrid take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
30' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. Atl. Madrid have a corner.
28' Atl. Madrid take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
27' The referee blows his whistle as Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) was too aggressive in his challenge.
26' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
24' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
23' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Guillermo Cuadra saw the whole situation.
21' Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe) was too forceful with his tackle and Guillermo Cuadra interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
19' Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
16' Luis Milla (Getafe) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
14' Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
12' The Getafe players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
10' Rough tackle by Omar Alderete (Getafe). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
7' Diego Rico (Getafe) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
3' The Atl. Madrid players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Atl. Madrid will have the kick-off.
Guillermo Cuadra will supervise the game today.
